look: Abyssal Gel, a A-rank GKOM variant from the Gloam Oozes family: towering black tide of gel swallowing the light around it. Family anatomy: translucent jellies and gel cubes with half-dissolved crystal shards drifting inside. Build: large, heavy and imposing. GKOM rank cue: most of the body sheathed in GKOM crystal, natural surface only at the seams; the crystals are murky violet gel crystal. Element Water: aqua, deep blue and pearl accents, vivid sweeping ribbons of water, bubbles and moonlit spray
